steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: How long have we been standing here...?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: I can't even see the core city anymore...

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: Your wounds haven't healed yet. Get some rest. I will take care of things here.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: No, that's not what I meant. Err, how should I say this? You know what I mean...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: I'm hoping Amiya and the others will be back soon.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: Yeah.
It's a marvelous thing to show concern for your leader. That is proof of Rhodes Island's unity. However, pushing yourself so hard is not going to accomplish anything.
You can barely stand still, young man. You can stop hiding your wounds from your friend. I see right through that.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Huh? You... Hellagur?

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: Hellagur is right. We will need you sooner or later, but not now.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: We'll fight alongside one another once your wounds are healed.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Heh... Please, I'm a nobody. Who am I to fight alongside the Radiant Knight?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: —That said, Hellagur. Owing to the situation we're in, perhaps you should stay inside the ship...

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Of course, of course, but Neon and the children are still being checked upon. I will see them as soon as that is over.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: In that case... Right, okay. If things take a wrong turn, I guess I'll just be in the way since I'm injured.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: I'll head back, then. Be safe.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: The view here is vast and wide. We can see the berserk city running amok from here.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: Fine eyes as always.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: As always.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: You and your men covered several squads and helped them infiltrate Chernobog, though the plan I'd heard from that doctor was a most fearless one.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Fearlessness, bravery, and resolve may be priceless qualities, but they always lead to sacrifices on the battlefield.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: Fearlessness doesn't mean not having a plan.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: I never imagined you and your men to be such masterful warriors.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: You use the sandstorm and the light as cover. Such a surprise attack is no easy feat even for seasoned veterans. You have my admiration.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: I heard you were the one who returned Scout's remains to Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Are the other Rhodes Islanders quite like him?

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: I cannot say for certain. I think each and every operator has a different kind of resolve than Scout, even me.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: But all of us operators—all of us who are willing to fight for the Infected and for Rhodes Island—are unafraid of battle.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Everyone fights for a different reason.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: That is why when they are permitted an ambitious, magnificent dream that matches all that they have ever wished for, they will find themselves lost in the current.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: Are you talking about Reunion?

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: All one and the same...

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: The operators who infiltrated the city are the most unwavering lot I've met, and they all have the most steadfast convictions.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: I choose to believe in those convictions. Their convictions.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: This is my duty as a Rhodes Island Operator. Also, I must thank you for going through the trouble of bringing back Scout's comms. I am sure Chernobog must have been in a very bad situation at the time.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Sadly... I never had the chance to meet that fine warrior.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: His sacrifice roused his fellow soldiers. I believe the effects of his will can still be seen around us.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Yet 'sacrifice' is not a thing of the past. In this war before us, Rhodes Island will see yet more sacrifice. Much more.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: Rather than the sacrifices themselves, I think we should think more about what those sacrifices have brought us.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: My job is merely to stand guard here from afar and to await the fruits of justice that they are fighting for with their own blood.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: I've met many from Kazimierz like you, young knight, but most of them flawed.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: I heard from the other operators that you are known as the Radiant Knight. Your performance in the past has indeed been truly memorable—

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: —From what I know, in present day Kazimierz, knights who receive a title of only a single word are, without exception, among the very best of their ranks. Why did you leave your homeland, if I may ask?

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: What the knighthood means now in Kazimierz is very different.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: You, too, left Ursus behind, you said so yourself. Everyone fights for a different reason.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Young Radiant Knight, what is your name?

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: Margaret Nearl. You may also call me operator codename Nearl.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: So that's why... they call you 'Nearl.'

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary A
steps.text: Where the hell's W?! She goes missing now, of all times?!

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary B
steps.text: You're still counting on her...? Don't you remember how Garcin died?

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary A
steps.text: You—

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary B
steps.text: Save it! Who knows what W and Talulah are thinking?

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary B
steps.text: We mercenaries put our lives on the line for nothing but coin, no? Don't listen to these Infected. They want their future, and it's got nothing to do with us!

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary B
steps.text: All we gotta do is kill the enemies in front of our faces and keep following the side that wins. That's been my policy all along.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary B
steps.text: But now we can't get in touch with W, and Talulah's abandoned us. Until we get orders from either of them, whose orders are we supposed to follow?! Tell me!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: What's going on? Why are these Sarkaz...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Mmph!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Looks like they're fighting amongst themselves. Let's take this chance and slip past. Quick... don't let them spot us. We need to follow the plan and secure the—

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: You, can't.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: I still remember the expression on Barclay's face even now. I had never seen such a complicated look on him, not even when he fought Pegasus himself.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: He told me we had a new enemy, besides Silverlance. A golden one.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Golden. The Golden Pegasus.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: A military commander that had only just come to the fore, reorganized multiple knight orders that had been ambushed within only a few hours, and then defended that gorge for three months with nothing but infantry.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Thanks to him, Ursus saw losses far greater than it expected. Its armies had to allocate attack ships to break that formation, and its winter campaign had to be reduced in scale.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: The Nearls should be revered as heroes in Kazimierz.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: But now, a child that bears his blood... has been exiled from the country?

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: Just water under the bridge... It may be vile, but you needn't worry about that, Hellagur.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: Wheresoever I stand in this world, I take pride in my family name, Nearl.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: How is your grandfather?

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: He was already bedridden the last time I talked to my family...

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Time... Time is full of surprises. War leaves behind heroes. Wounds as well.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Do you despise Ursus, with all your heart?

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: I've never experienced war myself.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: But I know that Ursus has started many tragic wars. This truth will never cease to be, and there are many Kazimierz who despise the Ursus, even today.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: To refute this hatred... To teach those who lost their families and their homes in war to reject hate... That is a cruel punishment in its own right.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: You are a soldier... yet I am not a campaign knight.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: You are still of Kazimierz.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: Even now, I've never once denied that. I am willing to raise my sword for the ideal that Amiya speaks of, and for the Infected—

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: —But perhaps I will one day be back in Kazimierz.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: You are young still... Radiant Knight.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Yes... You are young. You yet have the chance to correct everything, including yourself.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: No... No way... Mephisto... He...

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: What is this? A transformation? Hey, do you still understand... Mmgh... Ah...

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Urghh... Ah... T-Tell them to... go...!

steps.name: Reunion Member A
steps.text: Talulah turned her back on us!

steps.name: Reunion Member B
steps.text: That's not possible! Patriot's the real traitor! Kill him! He's a Sarkaz, he's a Wendigo, and he's an Ursus Army soldier! What part of him can we even trust?!

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary A
steps.text: Tsk. Looks like it's our turn to pick sides.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary A
steps.text: What do you mean? W just straight up disappeared after she gave us the order to hold here. Do you think Talulah might already have killed her?

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary A
steps.text: How are the other squads...?

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary B
steps.text: Can't get to them. Maybe those Infected nutjobs started their attack on Patriot—

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary B
steps.text: —It's practically still anarchy out here for most of these folks. I mean, they aren't soldiers. This all hit way more sudden than any coup I've heard of—

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary A
steps.text: Should we regroup with Patriot's squad?

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary B
steps.text: —Sarkaz follow Sarkaz. Isn't that the iron law?

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary B
steps.text: Besides, he's Buldrokkas'tee.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Chernobog.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Its march onwards has not yet ceased.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: Did you live there for long?

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Not very long. Unfortunately, my lifespan is a little longer than your average Ursus man.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: But yes... To answer your question, I lived there.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Can you imagine? It was a nomadic city that hosted a theme park, department stores, and a park with a man-made lake.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: And now, the core city has abandoned the city blocks that were destroyed by the Catastrophe. With ease, it abandoned everything built by the hands of countless generations.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Even the city itself has become a frightening vessel of some wicked conspiracy.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Chernobog was far from beautiful. Its factories polluted the skies.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: But scores of innocent Ursus once lived there. Did anyone consider that? Did the ones responsible for instigating this conspiracy?

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: None of them ever did.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: Anger has blinded them.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: It has blinded everyone, ourselves included.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: What I see now as I gaze upon Chernobog now is not a city. It is a violent machine, powered by the destruction of the livelihoods of countless men, a machine driven by ambition.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: They abused the people's will to live. First, they took the right to live from the Infected. In the end, they even had to pry their will to live away from them.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: Your clinic there...

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: The things that I built have been destroyed far too many times, but as long as Neon and the others are fine, then the bricks in the ruins will be the only destruction there is.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Neon is fine, and Rhodes Island can provide the treatment they need. This is the only source of satisfaction I have.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: You've kept them from danger well. It would've been nigh impossible to evacuate them out of Chernobog after it was devastated by Reunion.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: I merely wanted to keep them safe.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: You cast aside your status as a military leader for that.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Yes... However, the land of Ursus chases me still.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Sometimes, when I lay my eyes upon Chernobog's ceaseless advance, I cannot tell whether Ursus is chasing me or leaving me behind.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: You do not want to make an enemy of Ursus...

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Even before its rotten body became engrossed in its endless onslaught, nothing in this world should have stood in Ursus's way.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: I once dedicated my life to Ursus. War is a soldier's calling, and I fulfilled the duty that I once believed in.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Nonetheless... in the years since, I made it out of that swamp and gazed upon the lands I once lived in from a different perspective.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Just like you, Radiant Knight.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: How will a Kazimierz, a Sami, a Lungmenite view the influences our past rulers have left on this world?

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: What do they think of Ursus's war?

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: You said you are yet to experience war. You are young, and you yet have the right to avoid these questions, but we all know the answers, deep in our hearts.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: There is no answer to war, and war needs not an answer.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: Violence cannot change anything...

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Right... violence.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: My fallen liege was the pride of Ursus. The aspiration that we once spent a lifetime chasing, in his words, all of Ursus was merely within arm's reach.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: But did he ever truly see the citizens of Ursus as a part of Ursus itself?

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Could he possibly...

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Patriot is dead!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: The Ursus spy is dead! He never believed in our cause, but Talulah will lead all Infected to victory!!

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Let Talulah and her foolish guards know that she cannot bend the will of all that gather here!

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Let them roar, and let them struggle. The traitors will be trampled and crushed by the shields of the enslaved. We will be as the mountains!

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: For the Captain! For... Patriot!

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Patriot...? The Wendigo? Buldrokkas'tee?

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: He...

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Wait...

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: The core city's command tower...

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: It's burning.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: Hm...

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: Amiya... They...

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: This is just the beginning.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Reunion's leader is no mere Infected. Her strength and strategy are hardly her truest side. The colossal shadow hanging over Reunion is starting to bare its fangs.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: We must be careful. Should their trickeries succeed, be it Rhodes Island, Lungmen, the Infected... No one will be able to escape this new torrent.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: I can only imagine the enemy Amiya is now facing...

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Rhodes Island's leader... She is far younger than you.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: She is facing either the Infected rioters roused by Reunion, the person behind this all, or perhaps...

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: ...It is possible that she and her friends will face Patriot.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: Patriot.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Say his name. He is true to it—A pure-blooded Wendigo, an Ursus army man.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: The leader of the Infected Guerrillas of the Northern Tundra, Buldrokkas'tee.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: He will be the last obstacle between Rhodes Island and Reunion.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: I heard about him during the emergency meeting. It's not often that Dr. Kal'tsit treats an enemy... a lone enemy with such caution...

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: He is worthy of her caution, for he is far more formidable an enemy than one can imagine.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: Do you two know each other?

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: We are old army buddies, and he is a true soldier.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: It has nothing to do with his blood, and it has even less to do with his accomplishments and rank.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: —He is a Wendigo, yet he is called an Ursus. Do you find that surprising?

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: Not at all.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: Our status and ideology should not be predetermined by our upbringing. This is something I've come to understand very well.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: You seem to think Rhodes Island hardly stands a chance in this battle?

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Not exactly...

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Buldrokkas'tee could not escape the cage he drew for himself with his ideals... because of the ideals he believed in.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Rhodes Island chose to slay Talulah to fulfill its own objective. This is rash, but it is their only way to realize some kind of compromise.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: But he is different. He became a symbol of the Infected and the rebels, and allowed it to expand.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Reunion is what it is because of him, and that is also why it will become his greatest weakness.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: You mean...?

a.text: The Chernobog command tower rages into an inferno.
Hellagur gazes at the red-stained sky, not looking away for a moment.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Fate has driven him into this dead end. He has long been aware, but he will never give in.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: He will fight until the end.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: And he will meet his fate.
